query: SELECT unsuitable_population, administration_route, storage_conditions FROM drug WHERE unsuitable_population != 'patients with cyst on the ovary' OR storage_conditions > 'avoid freezing';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: unsuitable_population <> 'patients with cyst on the ovary' OR storage_conditions > 'avoid freezing'
